#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The Chemical Industry Operations Professional Standard - chemical-industry-operations study demo.
Record demonstration. Property of Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
"""
TOPIC = "The Chemical Industry Operations Professional Standard"
TIER = "Advanced"
SLUG = "chemical-industry-operations"
KEY_POINTS = [
    "Benchmarked.",
    "Gaps closed.",
    "Ethics upheld.",
    "Learning continued.",
]
def study_card():
    bar = "=" * 60
    lines = [bar, TOPIC, "Tier: " + TIER + " | Archive: " + SLUG, bar]
    for i, p in enumerate(KEY_POINTS, 1):
        lines.append(str(i) + ". " + p)
    return "\n".join(lines)
def self_check():
    print(study_card())
    print()
    print("Self-check: cover the points and recite each in your own words.")
    print("Mastered when all %d points are recalled without looking." % len(KEY_POINTS))
if __name__ == "__main__":
    self_check()
